name: Ragtop
author: Stan Clemance
description: Made for convertibles, works for tablets, built for Omarchy: tablet mode when you fold the screen back or take the keyboard off, rotation that follows the device, a themed on-screen keyboard, and a way to arrange your windows with a finger by dragging them.

barWidget.description: Opens tiling mode, and locks rotation; only visible in tablet mode or while rotation is locked
